name: API basics
description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, query params, and custom headers.

get-one.name: GET a resource
get-one.postRequestScript:
sp.test('status is 200', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.code).to.equal(200); });
sp.test('returns the requested id', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.json().id).to.equal(42); });
get-one.description: A simple GET with a path parameter.

get-query.name: GET with query parameters
get-query.postRequestScript:
sp.test('status is 200', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.code).to.equal(200); });
sp.test('echoes the q parameter', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.json().query.q).to.equal('keyboard'); });
get-query.description: Query-string params are defined in the Params tab.

post-create.name: POST — create a resource
post-create.description: Send a JSON body and assert on the created resource.

put-replace.name: PUT — replace a resource
put-replace.postRequestScript:
sp.test('status is 200', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.code).to.equal(200); });
sp.test('reflects the new name', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.json().name).to.equal('Keyboard Pro'); });

set-header.name: Set a custom request header
set-header.postRequestScript:
sp.test('status is 200', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.code).to.equal(200); });
sp.test('custom header was sent', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.json()).to.have.property('x-request-id'); });
set-header.description: Adds X-Request-Id using the built-in {{$uuid}} variable; the mock echoes headers back.
